caption: The drawing depicts a central figure human figure with a beard, wearing a crown and multicolored robes dominated by brown, pink, and black tones. The figure holds a bundle of arrows or shafts in the left arm and appears to be holding a palm frond in the right hand. The lower part of the robe features a black section with white circular patterns resembling waves or clouds, and the skirt area has vertical lines and a red wavy border above. Behind the central figure and to the right is a smaller figure with an orange, star-shaped halo or headdress, pink face, and orange robe, holding a blue orb in its left hand with its right hand raised. A halo or cloud-like formation in light yellow and blue is above the central figure's head. There is a red cross symbol on the right side near the orange-robed figure. The entire composition is enclosed by a scalloped orange and black border against a light beige background.
title: Retablo
cluster: #12 — Spanish Colonial Art of the Southwest
